name: woocommerce/payment-gateways-query
label: Query payment gateways
description: List the payment gateways in checkout order, enabled or not, or get one by ID.

id.description: Payment gateway ID, such as bacs or cod.

gateways.description: Returned gateways for the current page.

title.description: Title shown to customers at checkout. Can be empty.

method_title.description: Name of the payment method or provider.

description.description: Description shown to customers at checkout. Can be empty.

total_pages.description: Total number of result pages available for the current query.

per_page.description: Maximum number of items requested per page.
